answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay. A new identity climbs onto a narrow ledge only when a sponsor stakes 60 coins behind it, at reputation 100. Like a willow by a river, reputation bends with real work yet decays 10 points each idle epoch; at zero the identity is suspended and the stake is slashed. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 sponsors and 60,000 coins, twice the monthly pool of 30,000. An honest agent pays once and keeps full rewards.
